```plato

    // How the polygon sits relative to the plane, with vertices within
    // `tolerance` of the plane counting as on it: Spanning when vertices lie
    // strictly on both sides, otherwise the side any strict vertex lies on,
    // otherwise Coplanar.
    RelationTo(p: Polygon3D, pl: Plane, tolerance: Number): PlaneRelation3D
    {
        var anyFront = p.Points.Any(q => pl.SignedDistance(q) > tolerance);
        var anyBack = p.Points.Any(q => pl.SignedDistance(q) < -tolerance);
        return anyFront && anyBack
            ? PlaneRelation3D.Spanning
            : (anyFront
                ? PlaneRelation3D.Front
                : (anyBack ? PlaneRelation3D.Back : PlaneRelation3D.Coplanar));
    }
```
